images.title: Zero follows the rules of numbers
images.purpose: Shows that 0 is a number with its own arithmetic: 25 + 0 = 25, 25 × 0 = 0, and 25 − 25 = 0.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three equation cards stacked in the centre with the 0 in each highlighted.
images.exact_structure: Three equal rounded cards stacked vertically with even spacing, white fill and thin dark outline. Card 1: 25 + 0 = 25. Card 2: 25 × 0 = 0. Card 3: 25 − 25 = 0. Every 0 is in reddish purple (#CC79A7), all other characters dark. Exactly 3 cards. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Zero is a number you can add, multiply and get as an answer.
images.description: Shows that 0 is a number with its own arithmetic: 25 + 0 = 25, 25 × 0 = 0, and 25 − 25 = 0.
images.context: Worked example also has 3 − 7 = −4 for the negatives; kept out to stay at three items.

image_decisions.why: Three short facts make 0 as a number concrete without clutter.
